slides.headline: The View Is Carrying The Whole Place
slides.body: You came for skyline therapy and suddenly the tiny table makes sense.

photo.prompt: an invented woman in a black satin top leaning on a Brickell rooftop railing, Miami skyline glowing behind her, friends laughing at a small crowded table, warm city lights and blue neon

slides.headline: The Host Says Five More Minutes
slides.body: You heard that at 10:12. It is now 10:47 and your group has formed a lobby society.

photo.prompt: invented group of friends dressed for a night out waiting near a sleek Brickell rooftop host stand, one checking phone time, elevator doors opening behind them, glossy marble lobby and neon signage

slides.headline: The Bar Line Has Its Own Group Chat
slides.body: You left for sparkling water and came back with three new acquaintances.

photo.prompt: a packed Brickell rooftop bar line with invented partygoers smiling and talking, bartender blurred in motion, blue underbar lights, skyline visible through glass walls

slides.headline: Someone Says Wynwood Is The Move
slides.body: Respectfully, that is a whole emotional commute from the 40th floor.

photo.prompt: invented friends on a Brickell rooftop couch debating the next move, one holding up a rideshare app, city lights below, DJ booth glowing in the background

slides.headline: You Check NEAR And See Everyone Upstairs
slides.body: The rooftop was questionable. The people list was undefeated.
